packer.name: Fulfilment Assistant
packer.desc: Packs orders at the office every workday and books the courier at 16:00. Needs stock at Suite 2B.

support.name: Customer Support
support.desc: Answers customers and settles returns for you (replace if in stock, otherwise refund).

marketer.name: Marketing Associate
marketer.desc: Runs socials and promotions: more shoppers see every listing.

developer.name: Software Developer
developer.desc: Builds software. Each developer adds dev hours to your SaaS product every workday.

barista.name: Barista
barista.needs_text: needs a café (lease the corner unit in Old Town)
barista.desc: Runs the counter at your café, Mon–Sat 7:00–17:00: about 14 cups an hour.

driver.name: Van Driver
driver.needs_text: needs a van (buy one from Sam at Dockside Motors)
driver.desc: Takes your van out on one posted delivery run every workday from 9:00 and banks the pay. Drivers rarely plan the route as well as you can: expect a longer way round, and rush runs they can't reach in time.

technician.name: Factory technician
technician.needs_text: Lease Unit 12 before hiring a technician.
technician.desc: Runs factory machines. Skill lowers defects; payroll remains due during downtime.

realty_agent.name: Realty agent
realty_agent.desc: Assists brokerage client matches. Payroll is due even when deals fail.
realty_agent.needs_text: Lease Harlow & Finch before hiring an agent.

media_designer.name: Campaign designer
media_designer.desc: Creative skill improves campaign click-through. Salary is due even when a pitch loses.
media_designer.needs_text: Lease The Loft before hiring campaign staff.

media_buyer.name: Media buyer
media_buyer.desc: A designer and media buyer unlock three simultaneous client campaigns.
media_buyer.needs_text: Lease The Loft before hiring campaign staff.

media_intern.name: Student intern
media_intern.desc: Low weekly pay, but slower production than an experienced designer.
media_intern.needs_text: Lease The Loft before hiring campaign staff.

housekeeper.name: Housekeeper
housekeeper.desc: Each housekeeper cleans about five rooms a day; rooms left dirty cannot be sold. Payroll is due even in low season.
housekeeper.needs_text: Take over or lease the Aster Inn before hiring hotel staff.

front_desk.name: Front desk agent
front_desk.desc: Check-in coverage lifts the service score in guest reviews.
front_desk.needs_text: Take over or lease the Aster Inn before hiring hotel staff.

electrician.name: Electrician
electrician.desc: Each electrician adds crew-days to installs on weekdays. Salary is due even when weather stops work.
electrician.needs_text: Lease the Helio warehouse before hiring an electrician.

auto_mechanic.name: Auto technician
auto_mechanic.desc: Cuts reconditioning and service costs by 20%, saves a workshop day and adds two dealership service bays. Salary is due even in a slow week.
auto_mechanic.needs_text: Open the auto desk before hiring a technician.

trade_coordinator.name: Trade Coordinator
trade_coordinator.needs_text: Lease Meridian Trade Desk before hiring a coordinator.
trade_coordinator.desc: Processes paid supplier shipping papers, customs corrections and bank documents during work hours.

traits.desc: Reliable: morale drops half as fast.
Friendly: lifts everyone's morale a little each week.
Ambitious: works harder, expects a raise within two months.
